name: Alpenhotel Weitlanbrunn
beschreibung: The Alpenhotel Weitlanbrunn is situated at an altitude of 1,200 meters in the East Tyrolean part of the Drau Valley. It features 38 rooms and suites with balconies and mountain views. The wellness area offers a Finnish sauna, a steam bath, and an outdoor pool. The cuisine emphasizes regional products and traditional Tyrolean dishes. In summer, the nearby nature park serves as an ideal starting point for hikes and mountain bike tours. In winter, the Hochpustertal and Kartitsch ski areas are directly accessible. Guests can also take advantage of free rental bicycles and the ski bus.
